'''2024 Charity David Garcia LS QMC''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Garcia]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Garcia]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Garcia LS QMC.txt|Download]]
